evidence: The paper states: "We built predictive models using Random Forest (RF), and subsequently combined with univariate statistics to rank m/z features connected to PSC-IBD." Their feature ranking method is "performed t-test and fold-change analyses within each fold, through MetaboShiny and calculated the combined V-score" where V = -log10(p-value) × log2(fold-change). They additionally use logistic regression z-values (|Z|) for ranking. The paper does not extract or use impurity-based variable importance from Random Forest.
